===== easyeda board --help (exit=0) =====
Manage Boards (板子/组合).

A Board groups exactly one schematic + one PCB — this is how the two are
kept together (and what `pcb import_changes` follows). Boards are identified
by NAME, not UUID.

Usage:
  easyeda board [flags]
  easyeda board [command]

Available Commands:
  copy        Copy a Board (its schematic + PCB) into a new Board
  create      Bind a schematic and/or PCB into a new Board (组合)
  current     Read the current Board (its bound schematic + PCB)
  delete      Delete a Board and the schematic + PCB documents it binds (no undo)
  list        List all Boards in the current project (name + schematic + pcb)
  new         Create a Board with a new schematic (one page) and a new PCB — works in an empty project
  rebind      Rebind a Board to the intended schematic + PCB (repair a stale binding)
  rename      Rename a Board by its current name

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for board
      --window string   EasyEDA window ID

Global Flags:
      --doc string                pin every mutating action to this schematic page / PCB (uuid or name): the CLI switches to it and confirms via live document.current before editing, refusing rather than land the edit on whatever page is foreground — removes the doc-switch race
      --force-stale-read string   deprecated compatibility option; stale PCB reads now continue with staleRisk and authoritative workflows still save, reload, then read back
      --host string               daemon host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --ports string              daemon port range (start-end) (default "60832-60841")
      --project string            route by project name/uuid instead of --window (survives windowId churn)
      --skip-version-check        deprecated compatibility option; version differences are diagnostic and no longer block actions

Use "easyeda board [command] --help" for more information about a command.
